summary: Phase 28.1 Final Scale + Security Hardening closeout — both backend and frontend GREEN. All 13 parity-lock pytests pass (7 storage_summary+week1 + 4 op_attachments_r2 + 2 legacy_backup_prune). All 5 live endpoints verified with admin token: /api/health ok:true; /api/admin/operational-attachments/storage-summary returns honest counts with migrated_pct=100.0 (32/32 r2-backed, 0 inline_b64); Day-1 questions endpoint returns 12 questions q1..q12 with debrief_type='day-1'; Week-1 questions endpoint returns 14 questions q1..q14 with first label='What friction repeated more than once?' and last label='What is the highest-value surgical improvement now?'; /api/operational-attachments/types returns 401 without token / 200 with admin token (route still mounted after factory signature change). Frontend /admin/dls/week-1-debrief renders Week-1 variant (kicker 'WEEK-1 REVIEW', headline 'Week-1 Live Ops Debrief', Q1 'What friction repeated more than once?'). Frontend /admin/dls/day-1-debrief still renders Day-1 variant (headline 'Day-1 Live Ops Debrief', Q1 'Where did dispatch hesitate?') — no regression. Factory two-router unpack pattern verified working in both unit tests and live preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Factory signature change from single APIRouter to (main_router, admin_router) tuple is clean and well-tested. Both routers register without collision and admin_router carries the storage-summary endpoint as documented.
Week-1 endpoint reuses Day-1 module with WEEK1_QUESTIONS constant and forced_type from URL — URL truth correctly overrides body spoofing per test_iter429_1_url_truth_overrides_body.

Live storage-summary discrepancy: review_request said masci has 60 attachments after backfill, live shows 32. Both are 100% r2-backed (0 inline). Not a regression — likely retention/cleanup between the backfill and this test run. Doctrine-locked invariant (migrated_pct=100.0 when all on r2) holds.

server.py still 11,500+ lines (per prior phase warning) — roadmap-only modularization for this phase is acceptable but tech-debt continues to accumulate. FastAPI on_event handlers and Pydantic v1 Config patterns still present.
_FakeCollection.aggregate in test_iter429_1 implements a faithful $facet shim — clean unit isolation without monkeypatching live Mongo.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 parity-lock tests passed; 5/5 live endpoints verified with admin token)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Week-1 variant renders correctly; Day-1 variant preserved with no leak; admin auth + variant prop wiring verified live)
